notes:
Background: VectorPulse builds a semantic search layer for mid-market B2B SaaS apps (product docs + support logs). Evaluating Hosted API first (fast MTTR) then move to Dedicated (predictable throughput, VPC) if POC meets SLOs.

Recent interactions (high-level):
- 2026-01-22: Intro call (Jordan) — use case overview, token cost sensitivity, mention existing vector DB (self-hosted Milvus).
- 2026-02-08: Initial POC kickoff (hosted) — 7-day smoke: ~150k semantic queries, batch backfill 120k docs (embedded via batch job). Fireflies id ff_2026-02-08_q1call_7a9c3b.
- 2026-02-18: SE walkthrough (Samir) — integration pattern: S3 -> batch embed -> push to Milvus; near-realtime pipeline for new docs using incremental jobs. Discussed vector schema, metadata join on Postgres.
- 2026-02-25: Latency/throughput bench notes — target 95p query latency <120ms, peak QPS ~40, expected average daily queries ~100k. Batch embedding throughput target during backfills ~200k embeddings/day.
- 2026-03-05: Security questionnaire submitted; vendor risk flagged need for KMS and audit log granularity.
- 2026-03-12: Pricing check-in; finance requested Dedicated committed pricing for 3x baseline throughput and VPC egress estimates.

POC requirements (user stated):
- Embedding fidelity: must match or exceed current offline embeddings (cosine recall threshold >0.82 on eval set).
- Integration: native SDK to push embeddings or REST API; ability to run embedding generation server-side (hosted) OR in Dedicated instance with local model variant.
- Vector DB compatibility: seamless export to Milvus and Redis (they will pilot both). Need canonical export format + metadata hooks.
- Throughput: support peak 30-50 QPS with 95p <120ms; batch backfill 200k/day; burst to 500k/day for 48h for migrations.
- Cost: very cost-sensitive on per-embedding generation cost; interested in batching/caching suggestions.
- Security: VPC private endpoints for Dedicated, KMS for keys, audit logs for all inference requests, SSO (SAML) for console.

Sales notes / paraphrases: "If we can show predictable <120ms 95p and work with Milvus, we'll move to Dedicated for steady-state traffic — finance needs a TCO for 12 months."

SE action items: Samir to run integration spike with Milvus export schema, baseline recall tests vs their eval set (10k queries), propose batching settings and cache TTL.

Next steps: dedicated pricing spreadsheet, schedule 90-min SE deep-dive week of 2026-03-15, provide Dedicated trial access (non-prod VPC), deliver TCO by 2026-03-26.
